title: Pre-CVE Advisory: Proxy Credential Leak in Requests & OpenSSL TLS Parsing Flaw
body: Security researchers disclosed two high-impact vulnerabilities prior to NVD publication. First, an SSRF and proxy credential leak affects Python requests versions prior to 2.31.0 when handling HTTP redirects. Second, a memory safety flaw affects Debian openssl versions before 1.1.1n-0+deb11u5 on Debian 11 systems. An unrelated internal utils helper was also audited with no impact.
